scenes.heading: Experience Fragments Concepts
scenes.narration: Workflows. Experience Fragments Concepts. In this video we review 7 key concepts you need to know for the certification.

scenes.question: What is an Experience Fragment?
scenes.heading: An Experience Fragment is a reusable group of components with content and layout that can be referenced within pages
scenes.body: The speech defines an Experience Fragment as a group of one or more components, including content and layout, that can be referenced within pages.
scenes.narration: What is an Experience Fragment? An Experience Fragment is a reusable group of components with content and layout that can be referenced within pages. The speech defines an Experience Fragment as a group of one or more components, including content and layout, that can be referenced within pages.

scenes.question: Which statement about nesting is true for Experience Fragments?
scenes.heading: An Experience Fragment can contain other Experience Fragments
scenes.body: The speech says an Experience Fragment can contain any component, and it can contain other Experience Fragments.
scenes.narration: Which statement about nesting is true for Experience Fragments? An Experience Fragment can contain other Experience Fragments. The speech says an Experience Fragment can contain any component, and it can contain other Experience Fragments.

scenes.question: What is the foundation used to create the root page of an Experience Fragment?
scenes.heading: An Experience Fragment is based on an editable template that creates its root page
scenes.body: The speech says an Experience Fragment is based on an editable template and that the template is used to create the root page of the fragment.
scenes.narration: What is the foundation used to create the root page of an Experience Fragment? An Experience Fragment is based on an editable template that creates its root page. scenes.question: Why would an exam scenario choose an Experience Fragment instead of copying page sections manually?
scenes.heading: Because Experience Fragments let you reuse parts of a page without copy and paste
scenes.body: The speech says Experience Fragments are used to reuse parts of a page without copy and paste, and also for headless use and omnichannel scenarios.

scenes.question: What template requirement applies to pages that use Experience Fragments?
scenes.heading: Experience Fragments can be used only on pages based on editable templates
scenes.body: The speech explicitly says Experience Fragments can only be used on pages that are based on editable templates.

scenes.question: What is the recommended way to restrict which templates can be used for Experience Fragments?
scenes.heading: Set the folder's Allowed Templates property, typically with a regular expression
scenes.body: The speech says the recommended way to restrict templates is the Allowed Templates property of the folder, often using a regular expression, and says instance-level setting is not recommended.

scenes.question: Which group grants write access for Experience Fragments?
scenes.heading: Users need the experience-fragments-editors group for write access
scenes.body: The speech says write access requires the user to be in the group experience-fragments-editors.
